records.jp: あのー……<CR>私、料理班じゃないんですけど
records.en_original: Um... I'm not part of the cooking team...
records.en_auxiliary: Um... I'm not part of the cooking team...
records.en: Um...<CR>I'm not on the cooking team, though.

records.jp: 暇を持て余して困っているとのお告げがあった
records.en_original: We were told that you had too much free time on your hands.
records.en_auxiliary: We were told that you had too much free time on your hands.
records.en: There was a prophecy that you were troubled by having too much free time.

records.jp: いやいや、暇なんかいくらあってもいいからね
records.en_original: What? No, there's no such thing as too much free time.
records.en_auxiliary: What? No, there's no such thing as too much free time.
records.en: No, no. There's no such thing as too much free time.

records.jp: それに料理のことあんまわかんないし
records.en_original: And I don't know anything about cooking.
records.en_auxiliary: And I don't know anything about cooking.
records.en: Besides, I don't know much about cooking.

records.jp: 安心してください。<CR>料理の知識は要りません
records.en_original: Don't worry, you don't need to know anything.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry, you don't need to know anything.
records.en: Rest assured.<CR>You won't need any cooking knowledge.

records.jp: え？　じゃ、今から何すんの？
records.en_original: Huh? Then what are we doing now?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Then what are we doing now?
records.en: Huh? Then what are we doing now?

records.jp: 作業室の大掃除です
records.en_original: Cleaning.
records.en_auxiliary: Cleaning.
records.en: We're giving the workroom a thorough cleaning.

records.jp: きらら
records.en_original: Kirara.
records.en_auxiliary: Kirara.
records.en: Kirara.

records.jp: きららだって家事は苦手だ。<CR>愛央も大人しく労働力になるのだ
records.en_original: I don't like doing chores either. But sometimes we have to do things we don't like.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't like doing chores either. But sometimes we have to do things we don't like.
records.en: Kirara is bad at housework too.<CR>Ao will quietly join the workforce as well.

records.jp: くう……
records.en_original: Aw...
records.en_auxiliary: Aw...
records.en: Urgh...

records.jp: さて、役割分担だけど
records.en_original: All right, let's split up the tasks.
records.en_auxiliary: All right, let's split up the tasks.
records.en: Now then, as for dividing up the work...

records.jp: 特に時間がかかりそうなのは<CR>コンロと流し、換気扇ね
records.en_original: The stovetop, the sink, and the exhaust fan will probably take the longest to clean.
records.en_auxiliary: The stovetop, the sink, and the exhaust fan will probably take the longest to clean.
records.en: The places that will probably take especially long are<CR>the stove, the sink, and the exhaust fan.

records.jp: わたし、換気扇を担当します
records.en_original: I'll take care of the exhaust fan.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll take care of the exhaust fan.
records.en: I'll take the exhaust fan.

records.jp: 一番汚れが溜まってるところでしょう？<CR>無理しなくていいわ。私がやる
records.en_original: Don't worry, you can leave that one to me. It's the hardest to clean after all.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry, you can leave that one to me. It's the hardest to clean after all.
records.en: That's where the most grime builds up, right?<CR>Don't push yourself. I'll do it.

records.jp: 安心してください。<CR>実はとっておきの裏技知ってるんです
records.en_original: Don't worry. I've got a secret technique!
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry. I've got a secret technique!
records.en: Rest assured.<CR>I actually know a special trick.

records.jp: そ、そう。<CR>それなら私はコンロ周りを掃除しようかしら
records.en_original: I-is that so? I suppose I'll clean around the stove tops.
records.en_auxiliary: I-is that so? I suppose I'll clean around the stove tops.
records.en: I-I see.<CR>Then I guess I'll clean around the stove.

records.jp: きららは流しか……
records.en_original: So I'm on sink duty then...
records.en_auxiliary: So I'm on sink duty then...
records.en: Kirara gets the sink, then...

records.jp: 星崎さんにはこの３か所のどこかのお手伝いを<CR>してもらえると嬉しいです
records.en_original: Ao, if you could help one of us with our section, that would be great.
records.en_auxiliary: Ao, if you could help one of us with our section, that would be great.
records.en: Hoshizaki-san, we would appreciate it if you could help<CR>with one of those three places.

records.jp: 換気扇を手伝おうかな。<CR>裏技っていうのも見てみたいし
records.en_original: I'll help with the exhaust fan. I wanna see this secret technique.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll help with the exhaust fan. I wanna see this secret technique.
records.en: Maybe I'll help with the exhaust fan.<CR>I want to see that special trick too.

records.jp: きっと驚きますよ。<CR>魔法みたいに取れるので
records.en_original: It's like magic!
records.en_auxiliary: It's like magic!
records.en: I'm sure you'll be surprised.<CR>The grime comes off like magic.

records.jp: ここの汚れは年季が入ってますからね。<CR>ふっふっふ、腕が鳴ります
records.en_original: There must be a whole year's worth of grime on this. Hehehe, this will be a challenge.
records.en_auxiliary: There must be a whole year's worth of grime on this. Hehehe, this will be a challenge.
records.en: The grime here has been building up for years.<CR>Heh heh heh, I'm itching to get started.

records.jp: （詩帆さんレベルになると、<CR>汚さで興奮するんだ）
records.en_original: (I guess once you get to Shiho's level of cleanliness, you start to enjoy a good mess.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I guess once you get to Shiho's level of cleanliness, you start to enjoy a good mess.)
records.en: (At Shiho-san's level,<CR>even grime gets her excited.)

records.jp: コンロを手伝おうかな
records.en_original: I'll help with the stove.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll help with the stove.
records.en: Maybe I'll help with the stove.

records.jp: 私は大丈夫よ。<CR>他を手伝ってあげて
records.en_original: Don't worry about me, I'll be fine alone. I'm sure the others could use some help.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry about me, I'll be fine alone. I'm sure the others could use some help.
records.en: I'm fine.<CR>Go help someone else.

records.jp: いやいや、コンロも大変でしょ。<CR>油汚れとかさ
records.en_original: Hey, come on, this isn't easy right? Grease is hard to get off this stuff.
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, come on, this isn't easy right? Grease is hard to get off this stuff.
records.en: No, no. The stove is hard too, right?<CR>With all the grease and everything.

records.jp: 遠慮なく頼ってよ。<CR>私、もう覚悟決まってるから
records.en_original: Let me give you a hand. I've already made up my mind.
records.en_auxiliary: Let me give you a hand. I've already made up my mind.
records.en: Don't hold back—rely on me.<CR>I've already resigned myself to this.

records.jp: あなたって面倒臭がりに見えて意外と……
records.en_original: For someone who seems so lazy you're surprisingly forward...
records.en_auxiliary: For someone who seems so lazy you're surprisingly forward...
records.en: For someone who looks like such a slacker, you are surprisingly...

records.jp: なに？
records.en_original: You say something?
records.en_auxiliary: You say something?
records.en: What?

records.jp: いえ、なんでもないわ
records.en_original: No, it's nothing.
records.en_auxiliary: No, it's nothing.
records.en: No, it's nothing.

records.jp: 流しを手伝おうかな。<CR>一緒に苦労を分かち合おう
records.en_original: I'll help with the sink. We all should do our part.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll help with the sink. We all should do our part.
records.en: Maybe I'll help with the sink.<CR>Let's share the hardship together.

records.jp: わかってくれるか同志！
records.en_original: That's the spirit, comrade!
records.en_auxiliary: That's the spirit, comrade!
records.en: You understand, comrade!

records.jp: ではまずクエン酸を用意して……
records.en_original: First, just gotta get the citric acid ready...
records.en_auxiliary: First, just gotta get the citric acid ready...
records.en: Then first, we prepare the citric acid...

records.jp: （あれ？　私より手慣れてる？）
records.en_original: (Huh? Seems like she's done this before.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Huh? Seems like she's done this before.)
records.en: (Huh? Is she better at this than I am?)

records.jp: （そっか、これまでの日々で<CR>二人に鍛え上げられたのか）
records.en_original: (I guess she's been trained by these two girls recently.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I guess she's been trained by these two girls recently.)
records.en: (I see. Those two must have trained her well<CR>over all this time.)

records.jp: （足引っ張らないように頑張ろう）
records.en_original: (I have to make sure I keep up.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I have to make sure I keep up.)
records.en: (I should do my best not to hold her back.)

records.jp: ありがとうございます。<CR>おかげさまでぴっかぴかです
records.en_original: Thank you so much for your help. It's practically shining now!
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you so much for your help. It's practically shining now!
records.en: Thank you.<CR>It's sparkling thanks to you.

records.jp: あのさ、もし、もしよかったらだけど<CR>何かご褒美のおやつ的なものは……
records.en_original: So, um... Could I maybe have, like, a snack as a reward for all my hard work? Possibly?
records.en_auxiliary: So, um... Could I maybe have, like, a snack as a reward for all my hard work? Possibly?
records.en: Hey, um... only if that's okay...<CR>could I maybe get a snack as a reward...?

records.jp: ありません
records.en_original: I'll have to refuse.
records.en_auxiliary: I'll have to refuse.
records.en: No.

records.jp: でも、夕ご飯のおかずをおまけするくらいなら……
records.en_original: But I might be able to arrange making your favorite for dinner tonight.
records.en_auxiliary: But I might be able to arrange making your favorite for dinner tonight.
records.en: But I could give you an extra side dish at dinner...

records.jp: よっしゃ！
records.en_original: Yay!
records.en_auxiliary: Yay!
records.en: All right!

records.jp: この感じなら次回もお願いできそうね
records.en_original: Looks like we can count on her help next time as well.
records.en_auxiliary: Looks like we can count on her help next time as well.
records.en: At this rate, it looks like we can ask you again next time.

records.jp: うむ。新たな人柱となってもらおう
records.en_original: Yes. A perfect sacrifice.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. A perfect sacrifice.
records.en: Indeed. Let her be our next sacrifice.
